webDesignChoices: Implement real handler preparation, walking, feeding and chance-based training before balance tuning.
Keep wanted, steps and learned independent; cancelling future training must not erase existing skills.
A deterministic scheduling approximation for native random hauling must be stated as a Web adaptation.
Follow/attack depend on a valid effective master, while autonomous rescue and hauling must remain possible without one.
Use actual carried item entities and bidirectional carried-patient ownership; interrupted tasks and saves must not clone or delete contents.
Revalidate current faction, health, skill, paths, targets and reservations during Web tasks; this can be stricter than individual native drivers.
Core Release is group attack permission around the master, not the Odyssey direct-target attack ability.
Restricting training food to Web-supported raw food is an explicit content adaptation, not an original raw-grain-only rule.
Clearing stale master IDs immediately after sale or invalid assignments is a Web cleanup policy; the bounded native trade method changes faction without directly erasing the reference.
